claim: Brian Harpole — a former Texas police officer and founder of the private firm Integrity Security Solutions, who headed Charlie Kirk's contracted security detail at Utah Valley University on September 10, 2025 — gave a first-hand account on the Shawn Ryan Show (episode #254, released November 17, 2025). Harpole said that at the hospital he cut Kirk's white "Freedom" T-shirt off so staff could attach a defibrillator. He also faulted the UVU campus police, recounting that a command-level officer had told him "I got you covered" regarding the rooftop area from which the fatal shot was fired, and urging a public-records (FOIA) request for that officer's phone communications. Harpole's account describes the shirt being cut as a routine medical step at the hospital; he does not describe shrapnel or an exploded microphone.

notes: Documents the senior on-scene witness's own account. The 'where is the freedom shirt / what if there's shrapnel' framing that circulates online rests on this episode, but Harpole's stated reason for cutting the shirt was to prep Kirk for a defibrillator — a standard trauma step — and he does not describe shrapnel or a mic charge. His criticism of UVU Police (the 'I got you covered' rooftop exchange, the FOIA suggestion) is his attributed allegation, not an established finding; UVU Police Chief is named 'Long' in the transcript.
